stay.id: Belum. Dia tahu sesuatu, dan ini mungkin satu-satunya kesempatan sebelum dia blokir nomor gue.
stay.en: Not yet. She knows something, and this might be my only chance before she blocks my number.

text.id: Halo? Siapa nih? Kalau dari media, sori ya, no comment.
text.en: Hello? Who's this? If you're press, sorry, no comment.

text.id: Gue Raka. Temennya Sekar.
text.en: It's Raka. Sekar's friend.

text.id: Raka... Raka yang ngedit itu? Serius? Sekar ngomongin lo terus, literally tiap abis rekaman.
text.en: Raka... Raka the editor? The Raka? Oh my god. Sekar talked about you all the time, literally after every recording.

text.id: Sori. Gimana Dinda? Gue pengen ke rumah, tapi gue nggak tahu gue masih diterima atau nggak.
text.en: Sorry. How's Dinda? I want to come by, but I don't know if I'm still welcome.

text.id: Apa yang lo bilang?
text.en: What do you say?

text.id: "Dinda butuh temen-temen Sekar sekarang."
text.en: "Dinda needs Sekar's friends right now."

text.id: "Gue udah baca chat lo sama Sekar."
text.en: "I've read your chat with Sekar."

text.id: Iya. Iya, nanti gue ke sana. Promise.
text.en: Yeah. Yeah, I'll come by. Promise.

text.id: Lo... apa? Itu chat pribadi, Ka. Lo nggak berhak baca.
text.en: You... what? That's private, Ka. You had no right.

text.id: Bentar. Tadi pagi yang bales di grup pake akun Sekar... itu lo? Lo gila ya? Semua orang panik.
text.en: Wait. This morning, whoever replied in the group from Sekar's account... that was you? Are you crazy? Everyone's freaking out.

text.id: Gue udah bilang ke polisi, gue nggak tahu apa-apa. Terakhir gue ngobrol sama Sekar itu soal jadwal rekaman. That's it.
text.en: I already told the police, I don't know anything. The last time I talked to Sekar it was about the recording schedule. That's it.

text.id: Tasya bohong. Tunjukkan buktinya.
text.en: Tasya is lying. Show the proof.

text.id: "Mereka nelpon gue. Lo beneran mau publish?" Senin lalu, seminggu sebelum dia hilang. Siapa "mereka", Tas?
text.en: "They called me. Are you really going to publish?" Last Monday, a week before she vanished. Who's "they", Tas?

text.id: ...Lo nggak ngerti.
text.en: ...You don't understand.

text.id: Ada orang PR. Dari perusahaan yang nawarin sponsor itu. Dia nelpon gue malem-malem. Ramah banget. Terlalu ramah.
text.en: There was a PR guy. From the company that offered the sponsorship. He called me late at night. So friendly. Too friendly.

text.id: Katanya Sekar "salah paham soal proyeknya". Kalau gue bisa bikin dia nggak publish, sponsornya tetep jalan. Buat gue aja.
text.en: He said Sekar had "misunderstood the project". If I could get her not to publish, the sponsorship would still go ahead. Just for me.

text.id: Gue nggak setuju! Gue cuma... nanya ke Sekar. Terus dia marah, terus gue nggak bales, karena gue malu.
text.en: I didn't say yes! I just... asked Sekar. Then she got angry, and I didn't reply, because I was ashamed.

text.id: Senin malem. Dia bilang mau ke mana?
text.en: Monday night. Did she say where she was going?

text.id: Siangnya dia DM gue di akun podcast. "Malem ini ketemu narsum di dermaga. Doain." Itu juga nggak gue bales.
text.en: That afternoon she DMed me on the podcast account. "Meeting a source at the pier tonight. Wish me luck." I didn't answer that either.

text.id: Sekar nulis "jangan percaya T" di buku catatannya.
text.en: Sekar wrote "don't trust T" in her notebook.

text.id: Wow. Oke. Jadi sekarang gue tersangkanya? "T" bisa siapa aja, Ka. Tetangga. Tukang parkir. Tante gue.
text.en: Wow. Okay. So now I'm the suspect? "T" could be anyone, Ka. A neighbor. The parking guy. My aunt.

text.id: Gue co-host-nya dua tahun. Lo ngilang setahun, terus dateng-dateng nuduh gue?
text.en: I've been her co-host for two years. You vanish for a year, then show up out of nowhere and accuse me?

text.id: Satu lagi, abis itu gue tutup. Senin siang dia bilang mau ketemu narsum di dermaga. Udah. Cari narsumnya. Jangan cari gue.
text.en: One more thing, then I'm hanging up. Monday afternoon she said she was meeting a source at the pier. That's it. Go find the source. Not me.

text.id: Itu apa hubungannya sama gue? Sori, Ka. Gue lagi ada janji. Nanti aja ya. Bye.
text.en: What does that have to do with me? Sorry, Ka. I'm meeting someone. Some other time. Bye.

text.id: Panggilan berakhir
text.en: Call ended
